preservation.weighting: equal per utterance for gains and errors; sample totals for PCM16 counts
preservation.interpretation: SI-SDR ignores global gain and polarity; rail contact alone does not prove clipping

timing.measurement: Host offline throughput, including DSP and neural inference; not ESP32 performance or acoustic latency
timing.excludes: compilation, model loading, disk I/O, metric computation

metric_execution.scope: metrics only; prior limits restored before inference

model_stats.precision: INT8 learned weights/activations/histories; INT32 biases/dots, bounded wider integer arithmetic; float32 external DSP
model_stats.scope: Includes per-cell duplicated LUT arrays currently owned by this Python reference; excludes graph/grid descriptors, Python objects and temporaries
model_stats.dsp_precision: float32 arrays; internal FFT precision follows the installed NumPy backend
model_stats.deployment_status: Complete scalar C audio path on host; ESP32 build and sustained timing require separate verification
model_stats.parameter_format: INT8 neural arrays, INT32 biases, exact stored LUTs; float32 external DSP constants
model_stats.parser_scope: Checks bounded topology, extents, integrity and arithmetic; hashes do not authenticate training lineage
model_stats.native_memory_scope: Host sizeof explicit buffers; excludes stack, caller audio I/O, vendor FFT tables and Python objects; packed blob can reside in flash

scope: Actual C PCM16 development selection; no final test or MCU timing
